text: Any one who gets a high position, such as that of a ruler, by undue influence instead of by good actions, will be despised by good men. As to the latter, they say what they ought to say, and do what they think is good for the public.
author: Confucius and Zengzi
speaker: Confucius
reference: The Classic of Filial Piety (Xiao Jing)
locator: Chapter IX, Government by the Sage
